Definition
[Metric dual of a vector field] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0293 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

For a vector field $X\in C^\infty (T\mathcal M^n)$, its metric dual is the covector field $X_b\in C^\infty (T^*\mathcal M^n)$ defined in local coordinates by \[ X_b=(X^i g_{ij})\, dx^j. \]
